content.title: About
content.content: Rum and cola is a popular mixed drink made from light or dark rum combined with cola. The beverage offers a sweet, slightly spicy flavor where the rum’s aroma complements the caramel‑vanilla notes of the soda.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The “Rum & Coke” cocktail originated in the United States in the early 1920s and quickly became a favorite among young people.
There are many variations: with lime (Rum & Coke with Lime), with mint (Mojito‑style), or spiced (Spiced Rum Coke).
In some countries it is considered a “classic” way to serve rum, replacing more elaborate cocktails.
Alcohol content in the finished drink usually ranges from 4‑7 % depending on the ratio.
Rum & Coke is often served in tall glasses over ice with a wedge of lime.

items.title: Moderate consumption may promote relaxation
items.content: Small amounts of alcohol have a calming effect, helping to reduce stress.

items.title: Contains antioxidants from cola
items.content: Caffeine and certain flavor compounds in cola possess antioxidant properties.

items.title: Quick energy boost from sugar
items.content: The sugar in cola raises blood glucose rapidly, providing a short‑term energy surge.

items.title: Alcohol‑related risk
items.content: Excessive intake can lead to intoxication, liver problems, and dependence.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Cola’s sugar contributes to cavities, weight gain, and glucose metabolism issues.

items.title: Caffeine
items.content: Caffeine may cause insomnia, rapid heartbeat, and increased anxiety.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: Alcohol can amplify the effects of certain drugs, such as sedatives.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Pour 40‑50 ml of rum into a glass filled with ice, top up with cola, give a gentle stir, and garnish with a lime or lemon wedge. Ratios can be adjusted to taste, but the classic mix is 1 part rum to 3‑4 parts cola.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store rum in a cool, dark place with the bottle tightly sealed. Keep opened cola refrigerated to maintain freshness and carbonation.
